title: DescribeResponse
description: The response to df.describe(), the mandatory handshake every compliant server answers. See docs/conventions/describe.md and ADR-0018. The factory validates every describe response against this schema before storing it; a server that answers but does not validate fails registration. Unknown top-level properties are rejected so that a typo (`capabilties`) fails loudly instead of registering as an empty capability list; forward compatibility lives in `extensions`, which is open — see its description and ADR-0020.

extensions.description: Open by design, and the only place a newer convention version may put fields an older factory has never heard of. A minor version may add capability ONLY here, or as an optional top-level field this schema declares — which means a server built against 1.1 still validates on a factory that only knows 1.0, provided its additions live here. The factory ignores keys it does not recognise rather than rejecting the response (ADR-0020's overlap window).

name.description: Human-readable server name, shown in the registry and the dashboard.

convention_version.description: The convention version this server speaks. Semver. The factory supports at least two concurrently (ADR-0020) and adapts per server using this value.

convention_versions.description: Every convention version this server can speak, when it speaks more than one. `convention_version` is the preferred one and MUST also appear here when this is present. The factory itself answers with this populated (ADR-0020).

domain.description: What kind of server this is. `factory` is reserved for Dark Factory answering its own handshake; `agent` marks an agent server (ADR-0028).

capabilities.description: Dotted df.* tool names this server implements. Anything outside the df. root is the server's own business and is not listed here (ADR-0018).

requires.description: Capabilities this server needs from elsewhere in order to function. Same dotted df.* form as `capabilities`.

effective_config.description: What this instance is actually pointed at — repo, branch, environment, subscription. MUST NOT contain secrets: it is stored in the registry and rendered in the dashboard.

capability.description: A dotted capability name rooted at df., e.g. `df.describe`, `df.files.read_many`, `df.vcs.open_pr`.
